name: Gauge
description: A `ProgressRing` that stops short of a full turn: `sweep` is how far round the dial goes and `start` where it begins, so a value reads as a needle position rather than as a proportion.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How far round the dial goes, in degrees. Three quarters of a turn by default.

props.name: start
props.description: Where it starts, in degrees clockwise from twelve o'clock. Bottom left by default.

a11y: `aria-hidden` with no `label`, and a `label` makes it `role="img"`. The value itself belongs in text: a dial's angle is not readable by anyone who cannot see it.
